spec.customIdea: A night market courier needs to find the correct delivery and bring it to a friendly shopkeeper.

plan.title: The Night Market Courier
plan.summary: In a vibrant night market, a young courier named Mira must deliver a special package to a friendly shopkeeper. With market stalls bustling and lanterns glowing, Mira and her friends follow four printed clues to identify the right basket and shop. Each solved check reveals one result digit. Together, the digits point to one final action that completes the delivery to the correct shopkeeper before the market closes.
plan.opening: Mira the courier carries a special package through the colorful night market. She must find the right shopkeeper before the lanterns go out. Complete four printed checks to collect four result digits. Their combined code identifies the final action that completes this mission.
plan.roles: Reader, Paper Handler, Checker and Recorder rotate after each checkpoint. For two players, combine jobs in pairs.
plan.goal: Mira identifies the correct basket and shopkeeper, then completes the special delivery before the night market closes.
plan.preparation: Print the Player Pack. Keep the adult guide and ending private. Hand out one challenge and its material at a time. Use pencils; cutting is optional.
plan.premise: Mira the courier carries a special package through the colorful night market. She must find the right shopkeeper before the lanterns go out.

stages.title: Check the witness statements
stages.task: Use the witness statements to eliminate two candidates. Record the remaining candidate and its result digit.

stages.connection: Save this result digit for checkpoint 5, then continue to checkpoint 2.

stages.title: Compare the printed evidence

stages.connection: Save this result digit for checkpoint 5, then continue to checkpoint 3.

stages.title: Arrange first, last and neighbours
stages.task: Arrange the four printed steps using the first, last and neighbouring-step rules. Record the matching order and result digit.

stages.title: Combine the four discoveries
stages.task: Copy your result digits from checkpoints 1-4 in order. Compare this code with the three final actions and choose the matching action.
stages.teamwork: Each explorer checks one earlier result. Compare all four before agreeing on the final action.
stages.connection: The four recorded discoveries identify the final action.
stages.storyContext: Friendly shopkeeper's painted door. Mira matches her collected digits to choose the final action that hands the package to the right shopkeeper.
